messages:
emma: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Leaving a thread for follow-up Qs about the org changes and hiring plan. I'll try to answer, and @leah and @raj will jump in for details. :wave:

sam: Quick one — is there a hiring freeze? We have 2 reqs open on my team.

leah: No global freeze. We're prioritizing roles tied to Dedicated and Runtime teams. If a req exists, please don't close it; we'll review prioritization this week. Ping me with the req ID.

matt: For engineering managers — are we adding or consolidating manager roles? I heard some consolidation.

raj: We're consolidating two infra manager roles into one senior manager role. That will reduce manager headcount by 1 but creates 2 senior IC ladder openings. Details in the org doc: https://redwood.internal/org-changes (internal)

cory: Does "prioritizing" mean hiring slower or reallocating budget? Product needs 3 PMs for upcoming launches.

emma: It means reallocating budget. We want to shift some hiring capacity to Product and Runtime this quarter. Not a blanket stop, but some teams will be asked to delay hires for a cycle.

sam: Will headcount targets change for Q3/Q4? Any numbers we can use for planning?

leah: Updated headcount targets will be posted tomorrow. Short answer: net +12 FTE for the year, with most growth in Dedicated, SRE, and Product.

dev-tools-bot: New doc uploaded: /docs/people/headcount-q3-q4-2026.md

matt: What about transfers — if someone wants to move from Eng infra to Runtime, how do we handle? Is there a window?

leah: Internal mobility remains open. Managers should approve a 2-week shadow then formal interview. We'll create a "mobility-pipeline" Slack channel and an internal form. @matt I'll DM details.

sam: Any changes to interview loops or hiring bar?

raj: Interview loops stay the same for ICs; manager loops will include an extra systems-level question for the consolidated manager role. Hiring bar unchanged.

cory: For folks on hiring panels — will we get training on the new role profile?

leah: Yes, training session Friday 11am. Recording will be available.

emma: Thanks all. If you've got specific team impact questions, drop them here or DM @leah. We'll post the org chart and headcount spreadsheet tomorrow. :thumbsup:
